sentences.text: Shri A.K. Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Himanshu Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/Sta

ORDER This is second bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in jail since 13.05.2023 in connection with Crime No.458/2022 registered at P.S.
Bijayraghav Garh, District- Katni, for the offence punishable under Sections 368, 370, 373, 376(3),
376(2)(N), 354K of IPC, Section 5L and 6 of POCSO Act, Section 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act and Section 9 of Bal Vivah Pratishodh Adhiniyam.

3. Prosecution story, in brief is that co-accused committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix and prosecutrix's marriage was performed with one Jujhar Singh who later on committed suicide Thereafter, prosecutrix was sent to present applicant.
He garlanded the prosecutrix and kept her with him.
From there, prosecutrix fled away.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 13.05.2023.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

Co- NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17296 2 MCRC-4522-2025 accused persons Shyam Singh Thakur and Amit Kori have been released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court on the Ranjeet @ Ranajeet Singh Sosidiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151971273/
1 ground that they are not biological father of fetus.

entities.text: Ranjeet @ Ranajeet Singh Sosidiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Case of present applicant is identical to that of aforesaid co-accused persons because as per DNA report, present applicant is also not biological father of fetus.
Further, main accused is Amit Kori who repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix and he has been released on bail by Coordinate bench of this Court.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Having regard to statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNSS as well as DNA report, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, second bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.

However, in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:17296 3 MCRC-4522-2025 case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9 . Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
11. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
